messages.subject: lavPredict
parts:
Hi,
I have a little problem with the function lavPredict. I wrote a sem which works pretty well (good indices of fitting, all parameters are significant for a level of 0.05 ) if i declare which are the ordinal variables of the model. Unfortunately,  the lavPredict function with argument this fitted sem returns only missing values. But the weird thing is that if i don't declare the ordinal variables as such, lavPredict works perfectly!
In the attachment you can find the dataset and i code used.

I would be grateful if someone would explain how i can handle with this problem.

On 11/19/2015 11:22 AM, Nicolò Russo wrote:
> Hi,
> I have a little problem with the function lavPredict. I wrote a sem
> which works pretty well (good indices of fitting, all parameters are
> significant for a level of 0.05 )

BUT, you get this warning:

2: In lav_object_post_check(lavobject) :
lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables is not positive
definite; use inspect(fit,"cov.lv") to investigate.

and this makes it impossible to compute factor scores.

In dev 0.5-21.922 (or higher), this now results in an error, and no
factor scores are returned.

Yves.
